explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration that bounds the height of I.under R by the height of I under Algebra.HasGoingDown. I searched Mathlib for HasGoingDown, GeneralizingMap, and height lemmas in Ideal/Height.lean, Ideal/GoingDown.lean, KrullsHeightTheorem.lean and the KrullDimension files. The nearest match is Ideal.height_eq_height_add_of_liesOver_of_hasGoingDown in KrullsHeightTheorem.lean. It needs IsNoetherianRing S and a prime P lying over a prime p, and it states an additive formula. That would give the inequality only for Noetherian S and prime P, and arbitrary I would also need the minimal-primes argument. IsLocalization.height_under is an equality for localizations and is unrelated to going down. Ideal.exists_ltSeries_of_hasGoingDown only lifts chains, so using it still needs the chain argument the proof carries out.
